title: dortmanna acutidens
intro: Dortmanna acutidens, commonly known as Asian wormwood or Chinese wormwood, is a plant species within the family Rutaceae. This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in Asian cultures, where it is valued for its health benefits and therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Dortmanna acutidens include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which have been linked to its ability to alleviate various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including limonoids and flavonoids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, which include modulating the immune system and exerting antiparasitic effects.
